cards.ex: It's absolutely pouring down out there; you'll need an umbrella.
cards.exUz: U yerda shiddatli yomg'ir yog'yapti; soyabon kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yomg'irning juda kuchli yog'ishi, qattiq yog'ish.

cards.ex: Her smile was like a ray of sunshine on a cloudy day.
cards.exUz: Uning tabassumi bulutli kunda quyosh nuridek edi.
cards.uzDef: Baxtli va quvnoq odam, xursandchilik olib keluvchi narsa.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'm staying home.
cards.exUz: Bugun o'zimni biroz yomon his qilyapman, shuning uchun uyda qolaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilmaslik, biroz kasal bo'lish.

cards.ex: The weather should clear up by this afternoon.
cards.exUz: Ob-havo bugun tushdan keyin ochilib ketishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havoning yaxshilanishi, bulutlar tarqalishi.

cards.ex: The new park is a breath of fresh air for the city.
cards.exUz: Yangi park shahar uchun toza havo kabi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va tetiklantiruvchi narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: We've weathered some tough storms, but we're still here.
cards.exUz: Biz bir nechta qiyin bo'ronlarni boshdan kechirdik, lekin hali ham shu yerdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni muvaffaqiyatli boshidan o'tkazish.

cards.ex: He's always chasing rainbows, never settling down.
cards.exUz: U har doim xom xayollarga beriladi, hech qachon o'rnashmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Erişib bo'lmaydigan narsalarni izlash, xayoliy maqsadlarga intilish.

cards.ex: There's a definite nip in the air this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab havoda sovuq seziladi.
cards.uzDef: Havo biroz sovuq bo'lishi, qish yaqinlashayotganini sezish.

cards.ex: I'll be there, come rain or shine.
cards.exUz: Men u yerda bo'laman, har qanday ob-havoda.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havo qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, har doim.

cards.ex: She's very down to earth, despite her success.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatiga qaramay, juda oddiy.
cards.uzDef: Realistik va amaliy, hech qanday takabburliksiz.

cards.ex: Make hay while the sun shines; we might not get another chance.
cards.exUz: Quyosh charaqlab turganda pichanni quritib ol; boshqa imkoniyat bo'lmasligi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi imkoniyatdan foydalanish, foydali vaqtni o'tkazish.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Bizda bir nechta yangi loyihalar rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda sodir bo'lishi rejalashtirilgan, tayyorlanayotgan.

cards.ex: The grass is always greener on the other side.
cards.exUz: O'zganiki har doim totli bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa joyda vaziyat yaxshiroq deb o'ylash.

cards.ex: She's been on cloud nine ever since she got engaged.
cards.exUz: U unashtirilganidan beri yetti osmonda uchib yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baxtli holatda bo'lish, juda xursand bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company is facing a perfect storm of economic problems.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya iqtisodiy muammolarning ideal bo'roni bilan yuzlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsalarning bir vaqtning o'zida sodir bo'lishi, juda yomon vaziyat.

cards.ex: There are some exciting new developments on the horizon.
cards.exUz: Ufqda ba'zi bir qiziqarli yangi o'zgarishlar bor.
cards.uzDef: Yaqin kelajakda sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The news of his resignation was a bolt from the blue.
cards.exUz: Uning iste'foga chiqishi haqidagi xabar kutilmagan xabar edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan va yoqimsiz xabar yoki voqea.

cards.ex: This peace and quiet is just the calm before the storm.
cards.exUz: Bu tinchlik va osoyishtalik bo'ron oldidan tinchlikdir.
cards.uzDef: Katta muammo yoki qiyinchilikdan oldingi tinch va xotirjam davr.

cards.ex: I got wind of the new project, but I don't know the details.
cards.exUz: Men yangi loyiha haqida eshitib qoldim, lekin tafsilotlarini bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy ma'lumotni eshitib qolish, xabar topish.

cards.ex: The pipes froze solid during the cold snap.
cards.exUz: Sovuqda quvurlar muzlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq muzlagan, qattiq muzga aylangan.

cards.ex: We couldn't see anything in the thick fog.
cards.exUz: Qalin tumanda hech narsa ko'ra olmadik.
cards.uzDef: Juda zich tuman, ko'rish qobiliyati cheklangan.

cards.ex: A gentle breeze was blowing through the trees.
cards.exUz: Daraxtlar orasidan mayin shabada esardi.
cards.uzDef: Yengil va yoqimli shamol.

cards.ex: The scorching heat made it difficult to work outside.
cards.exUz: Jazirama issiqda tashqarida ishlash qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yuqori harorat, jazirama issiq.

cards.ex: There was patchy fog on the way to work this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab ishga borishda tarqoq tuman bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Joy-joyida bo'lgan tuman, bir xil emas.

cards.ex: The election resulted in a landslide victory for the new party.
cards.exUz: Saylov yangi partiyaning katta g'alabasi bilan yakunlandi.
cards.uzDef: Katta farq bilan qozonilgan g'alaba.

cards.ex: The desert is as dry as a bone.
cards.exUz: Cho'l juda quruq.
cards.uzDef: Juda quruq, hech qanday namlik yo'q.

cards.ex: There was a touch of frost on the grass this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab o't ustida qirov bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Yengil qirov, sovuq harorat.

cards.ex: We spent the afternoon basking in the sunshine.
cards.exUz: Biz tushdan keyin quyoshda toblanib o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Quyoshda isinish, quyosh nuridan zavqlanish.

cards.ex: It was raw weather, with a biting wind and sleet.
cards.exUz: Qattiq shamol va muzli yomg'ir bilan qo'pol ob-havo edi.
cards.uzDef: Qo'pol, yoqimsiz ob-havo sharoitlari.

cards.ex: The old sailor had a weather-beaten face.
cards.exUz: Qari dengizchining yuzi ob-havodan terilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havo ta'siridan terilgan, qizarib ketgan yuz.
